answer_1.quote: This paper investigates whether and how we can transform Manchester QB samples into questions that resemble natural, Cranfield questions. To this end, we propose syntactic transformations (NATURALIZATION) that convert QB elicitations into QB-TRANS questions that resemble NQ

answer_2.quote: Average F1 scores on NQ test set vary by less than 6 points, which implies that QB-TRANS can replace NQ training data. We also combine NQ with QB-TRANS as training data in our supervised setting... improving F1 (tested on NQ test set) by 10 points compared to training on only NQ.
